answer: Milestone bond: each identity docks at one wharf berth and locks 70 credit under one key. An auditor replays its work in a karst audit; rented work fails the replay and burns the tranche. Then it files a sonnet, a 14-line signed declaration, hashed, public; a mismatch burns the rest. Each pays 45 per stage; 1,000 fakes pay 135,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 165,000. One honest filing pays 135, keeps its share, bond returned.
